description: This ultra-quick (classic) Dark Side deck simulates the sheer numbers of the Empire. This deck (under my control) is undefeated.
strategy: Use Fondor as a starting location, and Prepared Defenses as a starting interrupt. Play Mobilization Points and Something Special Planned For Them via Prepared Defenses. Immediately take Executor into your hand with Mobilization Points. Tarkin, Motti, and Vader are used to get tons of storm troopers out for free, while the star destroyers get the TIEs out for free. Use the powerful characters and star destroyers to quell any strong rebel forces while your overwhelming number of TIEs and storm troopers force drain and outnumber. Astromech Shortage is a good thorn in the Rebels’ side. The only card I wouldn’t mind changing is Put All Sections On Alert. Since all of the systems in this deck are within 2 parsecs of each other, Executor won’t have any trouble going to different systems.
